title: Viewing the line-by-line revision history for a file

steps.quote: Click to open the file whose line history you want to view.
steps.text: Click to open the file whose line history you want to view.
steps.skip_reason: Covered by the start URL (a file in the repository).

steps.text: Above the file content, click Blame.
steps.goal: A line-by-line blame view, with code grouped by commit, is visible

steps.quote: To return to the raw code view, above the file content, click **Code**.
steps.text: To return to the raw code view, above the file content, click Code.
steps.goal: The file's code view is shown again

steps.quote: If you are viewing a Markdown file, above the file content, you can also click **Preview** to return to the view with Markdown formatting applied.
steps.text: If you are viewing a Markdown file, above the file content, you can also click Preview to return to the view with Markdown formatting applied.
steps.goal: The Markdown file is shown with formatting applied
